Almeida Benalcázar, E., Noorman, H., Maciel Filho, R. and Posada, J.A. (2020). Additional file 1 for: Modeling ethanol production through gas fermentation: a biothermodynamics and mass transfer-based hybrid model for microbial growth in a large-scale bubble column bioreactor. Biotechnology for Biofuels 13. DOI 10.1186/s13068-020-01695 (final check character not printed in the file; confirm)

Supplementary file (13068_2020_1695_MOESM1_ESM.docx) of the 2020 Biotechnology for Biofuels modelling paper, NOT of the 2022 Computers & Chemical Engineering paper (almeida-benalcazar_2022_001) that the to-get row "Almeida Benalcazar et al. 2022 supporting information" asks for, so that row stays open. Content: Gibbs-energy threshold figures (S1-S2), biomass-yield validation data from Valgepea 2017/2018 and Richter 2013 (Table SI1, specific uptake and production rates in mol/Cmolx/h), the list of mass-balance equations and constraints (Table S2), NRTL ethanol-water VLE equations and Antoine constants (Table S3), gas-flow equations, and the list of equations for compression, cooling, condensation and distillation power (Table S4; the equations are images, no values). No techno-economic, energy-per-unit or plant-level numbers are printed: nothing usable on its own for fermenter_syngas. The parent 2020 paper (not held) prints the energy results and may be worth fetching instead.
